Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.

You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.

Location: Pune / Remote

Experience: 3–6 years

Type: Full-time

What You’ll Do
  • Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases

  • 3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)

  • Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process
  • Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning & professional trainings).
  • Flexible working hours and remote options.
  • A collaborative and innovative team culture.

Koru UX Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

himalayas::hm_nvidia_senior-software-eng.title: Senior Software Engineer - Autonomous Vehicles
himalayas::hm_nvidia_senior-software-eng.description:
Categories: Developer, Software Engineer, Autonomous Vehicle Software Engineer, Embedded Software Engineer, C# Software Engineer, GPU Software Engineer

Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on.

Self-driving cars need to know where the road goes, in real time, with no prior map to lean on. We’re building the perception-based world model stack that makes this possible. It takes raw multi-sensor input and produces a live, accurate 3D model of lanes, boundaries, crosswalks, intersection topology, and traffic control semantics. It also fuses perception, map, and localization data into a consistent model of the driving environment that the rest of the driving stack depends on. You will join a team of world-class software engineers improving these algorithms. This is a software engineering role: algorithms are only as good as the software that runs them, so we need an engineer who obsesses over quality, performance, and architecture, and who can turn algorithmic ideas into safe, fast, maintainable code for production vehicles on NVIDIA DRIVE Orin and Thor. Your code will meet ASIL-B/D requirements and ship across L2++, L3, and L4 programs. What you’ll be doing: Build and own core online world model and context fusion software that runs in the car, from architecture through implementation to deployment. Write production C++ for real-time embedded systems, with a focus on correctness, determinism, and maintainability. Design software architecture, interfaces, and data flows that promote code reuse and clean boundaries across vehicle programs, while meeting CPU, memory, and latency budgets. Profile complex pipelines, find bottlenecks, and deliver measurable improvements in CPU utilization, memory usage, and end-to-end latency, backed by reproducible measurements on Orin and Thor. Develop benchmarks and performance regression tests that track improvements and prevent regressions. Use GPU parallelism (CUDA) where it helps to accelerate compute-heavy mapping components. Implement and integrate algorithmic solutions from the mapping team into NVIDIA ’s AV stack, working closely with algorithm engineers to understand and refine them while preserving behavior, output quality, and correctness. Develop to automotive safety standards (ASIL-B/D): apply strong static analysis, follow safety-oriented coding guidelines, and achieve 100% line and branch coverage with rigorous unit and integration tests. Build software that is robust to the varied conditions and failure modes of vehicles operating around the world. Contribute to code reviews and uphold the team’s quality and safety expectations. What we need to see: PhD with 1+ year, MS with 3+ years, or BS with 5+ years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience building robust, production-quality software 3+ years of professional modern C++ development, with a strong grasp of memory management, concurrency, and performance. Demonstrated ability to profile and optimize CPU utilization, memory consumption, and latency using profilers and benchmarks under representative workloads. Solid understanding of algorithms and data structures and their impact on performance. Experience designing software architecture and APIs for large, long-lived codebases. A quality-first, systematic approach to debugging and optimization: comfort with static analysis, unit testing, and high-coverage test strategies. 🌍 About the Company Our client is a Cyprus-based FinTech company operating in the payments and financial technology sector , with a focus on payment infrastructure, digital wallets, and cryptocurrency -related services. The company is looking for a Senior Angular Developer to develop and improve complex frontend applications, strengthen its existing architecture, and deliver reliable, maintainable solutions for its payment products. 💼 About the Role As a Senior Angular Developer , you will deliver complex frontend functionality and take responsibility for the quality of your work. You will make well-reasoned technical decisions, investigate root causes, and build maintainable solutions within an existing architecture. The role suits an engineer who can work independently while communicating risks, questions, and proposed changes early. 🔍 Responsibilities Develop and maintain complex applications using Angular and TypeScript ; Deliver assigned features in line with agreed requirements , architecture, and scope; Assess technical approaches and explain their advantages , limitations, and wider implications; Design reusable components and maintainable frontend structures; Integrate REST APIs with appropriate error handling and coverage of edge cases; Investigate defects, identify root causes, and improve application performance; Translate Figma designs into accurate, responsive interfaces; Review and refactor existing code while protecting current functionality; Communicate delivery risks, technical concerns, and blockers at an early stage; Review your own work and take responsibility for a tested, working result. 🎓 Requirements Professional Angular development experience at strong middle or senior level; Advanced knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS/SCSS ; Strong understanding of Angular application architecture and dependency injection; Practical experience with Standalone Components, Signals, OnPush, and Change Detection ; Deep knowledge of RxJS , reactive programming, and asynchronous operations; Experience with Reactive Forms, Angular Router, REST API integration, and application state management; Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, refactoring, and performance optimization skills; Proficiency with Git and the ability to produce responsive interfaces from Figma designs. Nice to Have Experience building UI component libraries or design systems; Knowledge of SSR, SEO, NgRx , or other state management libraries; Experience developing content editors, charts, real-time applications, or other complex interfaces; Practical experience with unit and end-to-end testing; Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and frontend build processes. 🤝 Key Competencies Ability to work independently within complex, established codebases; Sound judgement when comparing technical approaches and selecting solutions; Accountability for commitments, scope, and delivery quality; Clear communication about technical decisions , mistakes, risks, and blockers; Constructive response to feedback and willingness to ask timely questions; Careful, critical use of AI-assisted development tools. ✨ The Employer Offers Ownership of technically challenging Angular development work ; Fully remote work format from any location; Scope to propose justified technical and architectural improvements ; Work involving reusable components, performance, maintainability, and complex interfaces; A quality-focused engineering culture built around accountability and transparency; The option to use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, or Codex to support development, testing, refactoring, and investigation; Further employment benefits and working arrangements to be confirmed during the hiring process. If you can independently deliver dependable Angular solutions, explain your decisions, and take responsibility for the finished result, submit your application for consideration. himalayas::hm_grupo-olx_product-designer.title: Product Designer Pleno (Monetização - Seller Acquisition)
himalayas::hm_grupo-olx_product-designer.description:
Categories: Design, Product Designer, UX Designer, UI Designer, UX Researcher, Interaction Designer

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online.

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país. Hoje temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro e em São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho é flexível e majoritariamente remoto, mas encontros presenciais poderão ocorrer de forma intencional, considerando a dinâmica e necessidade de cada time. Isso garante autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas definam suas rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo, sempre alinhadas aos objetivos, prioridades e ao propósito da empresa. Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade. Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa é a sua chance! Nessa posição de Product Designer Pleno , você irá somar ao nosso time de Design , atuando em parceria com Produto, Tecnologia e Dados para criar experiências que conectem as necessidades dos nossos usuários aos objetivos do negócio , contribuindo desde a descoberta dos problemas até a entrega e evolução das soluções. No dia a dia você vai: Atuar de forma colaborativa com PMs, pessoas de Engenharia, Dados e Design na construção e evolução das experiências do produto; Participar de processos de discovery e delivery, ajudando a transformar problemas e oportunidades em hipóteses e soluções; Analisar dados qualitativos e quantitativos para compreender comportamentos, identificar oportunidades e apoiar decisões de produto; Planejar e executar pesquisas com usuários, da definição do método e roteiro à análise e comunicação dos aprendizados; Criar jornadas, fluxos, wireframes, interfaces e protótipos, explorando diferentes caminhos para chegar às melhores soluções; Planejar e acompanhar testes e experimentos, utilizando aprendizados e métricas para evoluir as experiências; Acompanhar o desempenho das soluções implementadas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua; Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia durante a implementação, realizando Design QA e garantindo a qualidade da experiência entregue; Utilizar e contribuir com o nosso Design System, garantindo consistência e escalabilidade das soluções; Compartilhar decisões, aprendizados e resultados com o squad e com o time de Design, contribuindo para uma cultura de colaboração e qualidade de produto. E o que você precisa ter? Experiência atuando com Product Design em produtos digitais; Boa capacidade de estruturar problemas e transformar necessidades de usuários e do negócio em soluções de produto; Experiência com processos de discovery, pesquisa, ideação, prototipação e validação; Fundamentos de UX, UI, arquitetura da informação e design de interação; Experiência com Figma e construção de protótipos; Conhecimento e experiência na utilização de Design Systems; Capacidade de trabalhar com dados qualitativos e quantitativos para apoiar decisões de design; Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com diferentes disciplinas; Organização e autonomia para conduzir suas entregas, sabendo envolver outras pessoas quando necessário; Curiosidade e interesse em entender profundamente os problemas dos usuários e o impacto das soluções no negócio. Informações adicionais Mais sobre o Grupo OLX : No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real. Benefícios: 💰 Remuneração compatível com o mercado 🏥 Plano de Saúde 🦷 Plano Odontológico 🏦 Previdência Privada 💳 Benefícios flexíveis que se adaptam às suas necessidades 🍽️ Auxílio alimentação 📊 Aconselhamento financeiro 🏷️ Clube de vantagens 💻 Auxílio Home Office 🚗 Auxílio Mobilidade 🍼 Auxílio Criança 🛡️ Seguro de Vida 🗓️ Licenças estendidas 🏃‍♂️ Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar 🤝 Empréstimo consignado com taxas reduzidas Candidate-se e venha fazer parte dessa transformação conosco! About QuilrAI QuilrAI is an agent-native security company founded by security veterans to secure and operationalize the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle.

About QuilrAI QuilrAI is an agent-native security company founded by security veterans to secure and operationalize the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. We treat AI as a deployment problem—ensuring agents are assessed, governed by policy, and deployed via approved blueprints before they reach production, with every agent action decided before execution and verified afterward. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we partner with high-growth tech firms and enterprise customers across financial services, legal, and business operations to protect critical workflows against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and non-deterministic model behavior. About the role QuilrAI is hiring a Brand Designer to help build QuilrAI's foundations: the campaigns, launches, events and visual work that create a unique direction and voice, shaping a market leader. This is a role for someone with original creative ideas, not just for executing briefs. You will work directly with the CMO on brand, web, social, campaign and event design, with real ownership of ideas from the first week. We are looking for exceptional visual taste and serious design craft: someone with an instinct for composition, typography, color and detail, and the technical fluency to execute at a professional standard across digital, print and motion. This is a paid internship with a defined scope, a portfolio-worthy body of work, and a path to a full-time role for the right person. What you'll do Design on-brand work across the full surface area: website pages and modules, LinkedIn and social systems, sales and pitch decks, one-pagers, email, swag and launch collateral Design experiential and event creative: booth and stage environments, vehicle wraps, large-format print and billboards, signage, dimensional swag and installations, working with vendors and printers on specs and production Lead creative concepts, not just layouts: pitch campaign ideas, visual treatments and new ways to tell our stories, then build the comps that sell them internally Create original visual work within the guidelines: illustration, iconography, data visualization, motion and micro-animation, and templates the rest of the company can use Turn abstract product ideas (agent governance, observability, enforcement) into visuals people understand at a glance Produce finished, production-ready files, fast, and own the details: type, spacing, color, export specs, responsive behavior, print tolerances Build and maintain a visual library (Figma components, templates, asset packs) so the work scales without you in every file Bring outside references and a point of view every week: what is happening in design, motion, fashion, editorial and tech, and what we can learn from it Who we're looking for We are hiring for a world-class standard. This is what that means to us: An exceptional eye. Your work shows typographic precision, compositional control, restraint and a distinct visual voice. You can articulate why one solution is better than another, and you measure yourself against the best studios and brands in the world, not against the category you happen to be working in. Mastery of the craft and the tools. Figma is second nature (components, variants, auto layout, prototyping). You are highly proficient in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects or Premiere) and move between static, motion, web and large-format print without friction, including setting up print-ready files for vendors. Experience using generative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Firefly or similar) in a real workflow is a plus; so is front-end sense (HTML/CSS, Webflow, Framer). Creative leadership. You originate ideas rather than wait for them, build the case for your concepts, and present and defend your work confidently to a CMO and a CEO. You take direction well and push back with conviction when you believe in something. Range. You are equally strong on a social post, a keynote stage backdrop, a 30-second motion piece, a landing page and a vehicle wrap, and you understand how a single idea translates across all of them. Rigor and speed. You ship finished, production-ready work on real deadlines (launches, events, campaigns), with multiple projects open at once, and you own every detail: type, spacing, color, export specs, print tolerances. You ask sharp questions, then move. Intellectual curiosity. You do not need a security or AI background, but you need a genuine interest in making complex, technical ideas feel clear, human and compelling. Background.
